description: Report survey results in Power BI like a research agency - weighted, tested, defensible. Likert batteries, crosstabs with significance letters and NPS, over one survey table, in one visual. No export to SPSS or a survey platform, no DAX monastery: map Question, Answer and a Value, and switch views. Three views, one data shape Likert battery: diverging stacked bars with the neutral split on the axis, N/A answers detached, top and bottom box nets with their margin of error, means, sorting by net, dimensions with pooled score bars, tracker mode with the change since the previous wave, benchmark deltas against your norm, a collapsed disagree / neutral / agree view for executives, a colour swatch per answer named by the answer itself. Crosstab: banner tables with sticky headers, column %, values or an index vs Total, base row, heat shading, transpose, search, tracker mode with the change since the previous wave in every cell and a trend column, CSV export that keeps the letters - virtualized, so a 30,000-row banner scrolls like a native table. NPS: headline score as a number, badge or face with its margin of error, the 0-10 distribution, promoter / passive / detractor split, trend over waves with a rolling average, segment rows with their movement, the gap to your target in respondents. Says the finding, prints the footnote Smart caption: every view writes one sentence with the…
